name: Pelvic Dysplasia-Arthrogryposis of Lower Limbs Syndrome
aliases: Lower Limb Arthrogryposis with Pelvic Dysplasia

criteria.description: Radiographic evidence of pelvic dysplasia including hypoplastic iliac wings and abnormal acetabular development
Congenital joint contractures predominantly affecting the hips, knees, and ankles
Muscle hypoplasia or atrophy of lower limbs confirmed by clinical or imaging studies
Absence of cognitive impairment or neurological deficits

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of both major criteria (pelvic dysplasia and arthrogryposis of lower limbs) with supportive findings strengthens diagnosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by radiographic imaging; genetic testing may assist in differential diagnosis

imaging: Pelvic radiographs showing hypoplastic iliac wings and abnormal acetabular morphology
MRI or ultrasound demonstrating muscle hypoplasia in lower limbs
genetic: Possible mutations in genes related to connective tissue or musculoskeletal development (e.g., unknown specific gene associations)
other: Clinical examination revealing multiple joint contractures and limb deformities

distinguishingFeatures: More widespread joint involvement including upper limbs
Often associated with neurological or muscular disorders

redFlags: Signs of neurological impairment or developmental delay
references: Orphanet: Pelvic dysplasia-arthrogryposis of lower limbs syndrome - ORPHA2840
Hall JG. Arthrogryposis multiplex congenita: etiology, genetics, classification, diagnostic approach, and general aspects. J Pediatr Orthop B. 1997
